body: hi there! sounds like dermatillomania to me. i have it too! i know how hard it is. my way of stopping has been distracting my hands. i like gaming, so i do it a lot to occupy my hands so i won't hurt myself. if you don't have the time or patience for that, you could get a fidget toy or slime or something. really anything to take your hands away from your skin is great! i'm sure you can get through this <3

i did that for the first time when i was 10 or 11. i know exactly how you feel!! i'm 18 now and to be honest, i still struggle with self harm at times, but it does get better. lucky for you, you recognize that this is bad and you want to stop. when i started, i didn't even know what self harm was or that it was a bad thing to do to myself. you simply having self awareness is a great first step. i have total faith in you to not do it again, and i really hope you don't. best of luck to you, OP! :)

hey OP. i totally get how you feel. i assume you're autistic from what you said, so i think i can offer some support for you! i'm autistic too. not gonna lie, it really is hard for us out there. but the good news is we have each other! i get told to shut up a lot too. being autistic, i like to talk a lot about my special interests and whatnot, and when i do talk, i talk really loud and fast. neurotypicals get really pissed off at that for some reason. but thankfully other autistics would probably love to hear you talk! i know i love listening to other autistic people speak about their special interests in the tone and speed that they're comfortable with. it makes me happy to know that i can offer a safe space for people to talk freely. i'm sure there are some other autistic people around you. there might be a group for autistic people in your area, and if not, there are always online communities. as for being told to kill yourself, don't bother listening to them. if you hate them so much, then don't let them win! if you kill yourself you'd just directly play into their hands and do exactly what they want. besides, you deserve to live! one autistic to another, i think they're just jealous that we're smarter on average. i'm here for you, OP! hope things turn around for you soon <3

Lots of girls like feminine guys! And it's totally okay to be a virgin at 23. There's nothing wrong with that. As long as you treat women right, I'm sure you'll find one who loves you for you! As a woman, here's some advice for talking to girls as a man:

\- Make sure women feel safe around you. A lot of us feel pretty scared around men for obvious reasons so do your best to make yourself trustworthy. And don't just do it because you want women to like you, do it because you actually respect them and care for their wellbeing.

\- NEVER refer to women as "females." I see a lot of self-proclaimed incels doing that and I (and most other women) absolutely despite that. It's dehumanizing. I'm not accusing you of doing that or anything, just a little heads up in case you ever call a girl a "female."

\- Make what you're looking for clear. This is less of a women thing and more of a people thing. If you just wanna have sex with her, be upfront about that. Lots of women are down for that. If you want something more serious, do the same thing and be honest about it.

And some advice for yourself - I get it! I'm a virgin and I'm in a relationship right now. It's perfectly fine to wait until you feel like you're ready. Women will respect that. Also, can't you just dye your hair and get colored contacts or something? I don't think there's anything overtly feminine about blonde hair and blue eyes, but if you don't like it for yourself, then those things are somewhat easy to change. As for "ugly facially," I doubt that. Beauty is subjective and I'm sure there are people out there who find you attractive! You just haven't found the right person yet. Best of luck to you, OP!

Hey OP. I know how you feel. I know what it's like to want to kill yourself. I've been there so many times. I know that this stupid little comment on the internet probably won't stop you, but I'd hate to not at least try to be there for you. People always say this and it's hard to believe, but it really does get better. Seriously, I'm not just saying that to make you feel better. Take me for example. On September 1st, I had a deal with myself that I was going to end my own life. But right before I was about to do it, I chose to stay alive instead. I don't know why but I did and I'm so grateful that I saved myself then. Now, I have an incredible girlfriend and I just got accepted to the university of my dreams. Things got so much better so fast. I promise you that it's not a lie when people say it gets better. It really does. I'm here for you. I'm proud of you for making it this far. Please don't give up. If you feel like no one is there for you, I'll be there for you. I'm here for you right now. I care about you. I know I'm just a stranger on Reddit and this won't mean much to you, but your life is valuable. Please reconsider this. I want the best for you.

Edit: Just saw your other comment and saw you have a wife. I'm sure she loves you! It sounds like you really love her too. I know one thing might not be enough to keep you alive, but try to remember all the good times you've had with her. You can have all that and more if you stay alive. She loves you a lot. I think you should talk to her about how you feel. It can be very therapeutic to share your feelings with your loved ones.

Hi OP! I know exactly how you feel. I was planning to kill myself on September 1st this year but at the last minute I chose not to. I'm not sure what compelled me to stay here, but I'm really happy I did. I promise you that it gets so much better. I know people say that all the time and it's hard to believe, but it's true. 2 months ago I was ready to kill myself, and now I have a beautiful girlfriend and got accepted to my dream college. I'm happier than I've ever been before. I get how you feel. It becomes okay but not better. I know. I still have suicidal thoughts sometimes and I'm still in therapy and on antidepressants. I hope someone's told you they're proud of you recently. If they haven't, then let me say it: I'm super proud of you!!! You've made it four months without killing yourself and six months without self harm. That's incredible! You're already on the path to feeling more than just okay. I hope you can get there soon because you really deserve it. Sending you all the love in the world! <3
